summary: Product-scoped record for Bitvavo Earn, the current exchange-hosted Earn hub spanning Flex Staking, Fixed Staking and Lending. First-party materials identify different service providers and risk boundaries for Staking and Lending, so CYA does not collapse them into one universal asset-treatment model.
what_happened: Bitvavo currently offers an Earn hub covering Flex Staking, Fixed Staking and Lending. A 15 May 2025 first-party update introduced the current Flex/Fixed staking structure, while current first-party material documents Lending through Bitvavo Custody B.V. to professional counterparties and potentially margin users. Bitvavo states Staking is provided by Bitvavo B.V. and Lending by Bitvavo Custody B.V., and that both services are currently outside MiCA regulation. Flex and Fixed Staking also differ materially in liquidity and lock-up. The reviewed sources do not establish one original umbrella Earn launch date or one universal legal-title, custody, segregation or principal-protection treatment across all mechanisms.
uncertainty_notes: The reviewed sources establish current Earn operation and the 2025 Flex/Fixed staking redesign but do not establish an original umbrella Bitvavo Earn launch date. Staking and Lending have different providers, counterparties, mechanics and regulatory treatment and require product-specific interpretation.
notes: Current first-party material states that Staking and Lending are outside MiCA regulation and that regulated-service safeguards may not apply. This does not by itself determine legal title or insolvency treatment for every product.

summary: Product-scoped record for Coinmetro BTC Earn, a current fixed-term Bitcoin reward program with 3, 6, 12 and 24 month terms and rewards paid in BTC. Coinmetro's first-party copies of the same launch article expose inconsistent publication-date metadata, so CYA does not assign an exact launch date.
what_happened: Coinmetro currently presents BTC Earn as a fixed-term reward program. The first-party launch article describes commitment terms of 3, 6, 12 and 24 months, real-time BTC reward accrual, forfeiture of rewards on early exit and return of the committed BTC balance at term end. Coinmetro states that rewards are generated and distributed through its internal infrastructure without external lending platforms, third-party protocols, wrapped assets or synthetic tokens. Official copies of the same article currently expose conflicting publication dates across host and locale variants, so CYA does not convert any one displayed date into an exact canonical launch date or dated launch event. Product mechanics and return statements are recorded as first-party claims, not as proof of principal protection, solvency, segregation, legal title or insolvency treatment. The broader Coinmetro on-chain staking and MARs/XCM ecosystem is outside this narrow product identity.
uncertainty_notes: The product is current and its mechanics are documented by Coinmetro, but official copies of the same launch article expose conflicting publication dates, including different 2026 dates across host or locale variants. Exact launch_date therefore remains null. Reviewed public material also does not establish the underlying economic source of the internal reward, legal-title transfer, segregation or insolvency treatment.
notes: The statement that the full BTC balance is returned at term end is preserved only as a first-party product promise and is not converted into a CYA guarantee of principal, liquidity or solvency.
